pages.title: American Cheetah
pages.text: The American cheetah ($(o)Miracinonyx trumani$()) is an extinct cat that lived in the open country of western North America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It had long legs, a short face and a slender build very like the living cheetah's.$(br2)Despite this, genetic and anatomical studies show it was more closely related to the puma, its cheetah-like body being an example of convergent evolution.
